# Table layout

A column of short symbols next to a prose column: the prose column takes the spare width.

| Symbol | Name | Where it comes from | Unit |
|---|---|---|---|
| $R$ | series resistance | the conductors are not perfect; current heats them | $\Omega/\text{m}$ |
| $L$ | series inductance | current in the wires makes a magnetic field around them | H/m |
| $G$ | shunt conductance | the insulation between the wires leaks a little current | S/m |
| $C$ | shunt capacitance | the two wires are two conductors separated by insulation | F/m |

Table: The four line constants (per unit length)

A two-row table with short tall maths: kept on one page, and the short fraction column stays narrow.

| Family | Centre | Radius | Special members |
|---|---|---|---|
| constant $r$ | $\left(\frac{r}{1+r}, 0\right)$ on the real axis | $\frac{1}{1+r}$ | $r = 0$: the rim; $r = 1$: through the centre; $r \to \infty$: the point $(1, 0)$ |
| constant $x$ | $\left(1, \frac{1}{x}\right)$ on the line $u = 1$ | $\frac{1}{\lvert x\rvert}$ | $x = 0$: the real axis; $x = \pm1$: centre $(1, \pm1)$, radius 1 |
